_meta.notes: Era windows per §6.2. Year ranges loosely match the doc. year_end is exclusive. Communication/visibility multipliers scale the difficulty of the organisational machine as modernity creeps in.

eras.blurb: City-states, philosophical movements, early empires. Ideas travel by foot and letter. Religion is local, trade networks young.
Imperial overextension, mass migration, spiritual vacuum. The old networks are worthless. Maximum opportunity and maximum danger.
Feudal structures, dominant faiths, information crawls. Patience is rewarded. Merchants begin their ascendancy.
Printing press, reformation, global trade. Ideas now travel at speed. Nation-states emerge. Old feudal hosts lose value.
Mass politics, nationalism, public opinion. Shadow manipulation becomes harder as transparency rises. New tools required.
